svg.title: Glow logo concept board
svg.desc: The Glow spark beside Hum, Pulse and Tuck, three alignment options, actual-size tests and the colour proposal.
svg.text: Aligned with Hum, Pulse and Tuck: the same drawing at family scale, on their optical line and icon grid. One 24-unit line, an open centre.
IN THE FAMILY · SHARED 256 GRID, 24-UNIT LINE, 62 % ICON TRANSFORM
more ink than its siblings; icon at its own 2.2×.
The same curves at 88 %, lifted 2 units.
Ink spans x 28–228, the family's line span.
A turned on its diagonal: a taller glint,
but the only vertical mark in the row.
A with its tip handles opened 7° and 6°:
softer, wider centre, nearer a generic ✦.
ACTUAL SIZE · SMALL CUT (STROKE 32) AT 32 PX AND BELOW
App icon: 16 and 32 use the small cut
